description: Offline wake word & keyword spotting engine. One ONNX model detects multiple keywords. ONNX/TFLite, model <130KB, inference <10ms. Runs on Android, ESP32, Linux, Web, and Home Assistant (Wyoming protocol server + HA add-on). No cloud, no data usage.
